description: Na₅Ga₃F₁₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.88 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.72 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.83 Å. There are three inequivalent Ga³⁺ sites. In the first Ga³⁺ site, Ga³⁺ is bonded to six F¹⁻ atoms to form corner-sharing GaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 37°. There are a spread of Ga-F bond distances ranging from 1.88-1.92 Å. In the second Ga³⁺ site, Ga³⁺ is bonded to six F¹⁻ atoms to form corner-sharing GaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-43°. There are a spread of Ga-F bond distances ranging from 1.86-1.90 Å. In the third Ga³⁺ site, Ga³⁺ is bonded to six F¹⁻ atoms to form corner-sharing GaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 43°. There are a spread of Ga-F bond distances ranging from 1.88-1.95 Å. There are seven inequivalent F¹⁻ sites. In the first F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na¹⁺ and two Ga³⁺ atoms. In the second F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Ga³⁺ atom. In the third F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Ga³⁺ atom. In the fourth F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Na¹⁺ and two Ga³⁺ atoms. In the fifth F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Ga³⁺ atom. In the sixth F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Ga³⁺ atom to form distorted corner-sharing FNa₃Ga tetrahedra. In the seventh F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Ga³⁺ atom.
